sources.title: Scouting Jets kicker Jason Sanders
sources.description: Over the next few months, we’re breaking down all of the undrafted free agents signed by the Jets since April’s draft. However, today we are focusing on another recent veteran addition; kicker Jason Sanders. The 30-year old Sanders is listed at 5’11″ and 186 pounds and was a seventh round pick out of New Mexico […]
